meta.description: Accepts a note (iOS Shortcut or the MCP capture_note tool) and buffers it in an n8n data table. A poller on the user's own machine drains it into the Reckons.AI workspace. No Google, no third-party sync, nothing inbound to the laptop.

parameters.content:
## Why a data table, not Drive

Drive was only ever the medium both sides could reach. It costs a Google OAuth client, and when that client is deleted the whole capture path dies with an error no one sees.

The data table is already inside n8n — the buffer the phone needs when the laptop is off — and the laptop drains it on its own poll. One fewer vendor, one fewer credential, same guarantees.

## Delivery is AT-LEAST-ONCE

The poller writes locally, THEN acks. A crash between those two produces a duplicate, never a loss — and duplicates are harmless because pending rows carry deterministic ids and the app dedupes on import.

The other order would trade a harmless duplicate for a silent loss. Never make that trade on capture.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, captured: $('Build pending row').first().json.subject }) }}
